On Tue, Feb 15, 2022 at 11:45 AM Ahmad Qisa'i <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Hwee,
Thank you for the updated schedule and the proposed agenda. I agree with it.
Looking forward to it.
By the way, I have removed some of our colleagues' email addresses from this email loop for
tomorrow's meeting. There will be the DRG Office team under the leadership of Pak Walter who
will be joining the meeting tomorrow.
Salam,
Qisa'i
On Tue, Feb 15, 2022 at 10:00 AM Hwee En Tan < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Thanks everyone for your patience as we worked through the scheduling for our next
discussion.
The meeting is now confirmed for Wednesday, 16 February, 2-3pm JKT.
Ahead of our call tomorrow, here's our proposed agenda:
1. Expectation & objective alignment (USAID and Meta to share respective objectives for
this program - 10mins each; 10mins for discussion)
2. Partnership approach (duration - working towards a multi-year objective approach;
budget; renewal process, etc)
3. Program design (# of activities, university selection, geographical focus, etc)
We've also been expanding the program description - it's still work-in-progress ~80%
completed - for us to co-create further tomorrow.
Let us know if there are other agenda points any of you would like to add on.
